integrity: Complete infinite-family proof and independently implemented finite corroboration through k=5, with the finite computations not used as a substitute for the proof. Literature-priority searches are not a uniqueness guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Only strict optimal time-labelled burning sequences on cycles with length k^2 or k^2-1 (k>=2), under a one-coordinate one-edge source slide; no theorem for other cycles or source-order swaps. The later 2025 extended Nagao-Ogawa publication was not accessible in full. Independent assessment not performed.
title: A one-vertex phase transition in cyclic burning-sequence reconfiguration
